notes:
Summary: BlueQuill builds an internal developer platform (IDE plugins + search UI) used by engineering orgs to search code and architecture docs. Primary need: scalable embeddings + cost-effective reranking for top-K precision on code search.

Key technical constraints / asks: 
- Index scale: currently ~120M embeddings (code snippets, file chunks, package metadata). Expect 3x growth over 12 months.
- Reindexing: frequent incremental reindex (hourly for active repos), full reindex nightly for selected projects. Need low-latency pipeline and minimal re-ingest cost.
- Latency targets: 95th <= 250ms for interactive code search (excluding dev local network); p50 <= 120ms. Reranker acceptable <= 500ms for prioritized queries but want options to push heavy reranks to async jobs.
- Cost sensitivity: want predictable cost model; heavy read/traffic pattern during CI windows. Interested in batching, cache, and quantized model recommendations from Redwood Optimize.
- Model preferences: prefer open-source models (quantized LLM cross-encoder locally) with fallback to hosted Redwood models for spikes.
- Retrieval architecture preference: two-stage: ANN (HNSW/FAISS/ScaNN) for recall + light-weight bi-encoder for rerank candidates; cross-encoder only for top 5. Need guidance on index sharding and GPU placement.
- Security: SSO/SAML mandatory; audit logs + retention policies (3yr) required; data residency: EU for some teams, NA for others — VPC with region routing needed.

Quotes from stakeholders: 
- "We need search to be as fast as IDE autocomplete — devs will only adopt if latency feels instant." — Head of Developer Platform
- "Reranker cost is scary at our scale; show us hybrid options that avoid running cross-encoder on every query." — Staff ML Engineer

POC details: 
- Ingest pipeline: Kafka -> preprocess -> embedder (batch) -> ANN index (per-tenant sharding) -> nightly compaction. Expected cold-start windows during repo syncs.
- Current POC config: 2x c5-like instances + 2x A10G test nodes in Dedicated pool; experimenting with 8-bit quantized cross-encoder on a single GPU for top-5 rerank.

Blocking items: 
- Need Redwood SOC2/ISO evidence and KMS integration doc for legal.
- Budget committee needs 3-year TCO comparison (self-host vs Redwood Dedicated vs Private).
- SE follow-up: cost model for 120M -> 360M embeddings with hourly incremental updates.

Next steps (short): 
- Schedule NFR session (infra + SRE + security) w/ Redwood engineers (target by 2026-03-18).
- Deliver detailed cost simulation (token = embedding op + reranker inference) and recommended quantization profiles.
- Provide trimmed POC runbook: index shard sizing, caching policy, fallback routing for spike traffic.
